mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may inhibit CYP3A4 and has antiplatelet properties, potentially increasing minocycline levels and bleeding risk, while both agents can cause photosensitivity and GI upset.
action: Monitor for increased minocycline adverse effects (photosensitivity, GI symptoms, dizziness); counsel on sun protection and spacing doses; consider baseline and periodic monitoring if concurrent use is necessary.
